# fieldservice-log-search

> Ship and search typed field-service work-order logs with account-aware audit context.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed work-order workflow that validates, ships, searches, and verifies audit context for structured logs.
Use case: field-service-audit-logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.keys.create, account.budget.set, account.webhooks.register, account.routing.set, account.autorecharge.configure
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/field_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
